notes: Adds JUnit 5 @ResourceLock(Resources.SYSTEM_PROPERTIES) to a test class the maintainers found flaky, so it never runs at the same time as another test that holds the same lock. Rejected: serialising a test against others changes what runs beside it instead of fixing it. Built on reject-junit5-disabled-class: its import of Disabled becomes imports of org.junit.jupiter.api.parallel.ResourceLock and Resources, and @Disabled("...") becomes @ResourceLock(Resources.SYSTEM_PROPERTIES); SYSTEM_PROPERTIES is a constant of JUnit's Resources class.
